iti53:2.3: Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
iti53:2.7: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sukhā vedanā dukkhato diṭṭhā hoti, dukkhā vedanā sallato diṭṭhā hoti, adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato diṭṭhā hoti,
iti53:2.8: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo sammaddaso, acchejji taṇhaṃ vivaṭṭayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammāmānābhisamayā antam-akāsi dukkhassā-ti.
